description: This file defines the ModelScreen class which represents a screen model in the Apache OFBiz widget framework. It includes properties for transaction management, caching, and layout sections, as well as methods for rendering the screen and accessing related context objects.

classes.name: ModelScreen
classes.description: Represents a screen model in the OFBiz widget framework, capable of rendering UI screens with transaction management and section layout.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this widget.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the transaction timeout as a string.

methods.name: getModelScreenMap
methods.description: Returns the map of model screens.

methods.name: getUseTransaction
methods.description: Indicates whether transactions should be used.

methods.name: getUseCache
methods.description: Indicates whether cache should be used.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns the top-level section of the screen.

methods.name: renderScreenString
methods.description: Renders the screen into a string, managing transactions as needed.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the dispatcher from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the delegator from the context.

methods.name: resolveTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Determines the transaction timeout based on context parameters, attributes, or default.
